runtime_source: Playden registry and completed installation markers; no account/session state
limitations: An installed marker is not proof that a runtime is prepared, entitled, compatible, registered or safe to launch.
Title names, artwork and native title routing must come from independently verified metadata or runtime services.
Existing Playden static services are not linked or instantiated by this adapter.
Missing, inaccessible, malformed and oversized metadata are reported explicitly.
No writes, probes, migrations, account reads, network requests, installations, uninstalls or launches occur in the adapter.
Imported external games outside the managed registry await the separate source/location service adapter.
